description: Labeled detection corpus for scripts/detection_metrics.py. Each entry maps a report (by analysis_id 'report', sample 'sha256', or sample 'filename') to a ground-truth 'label' (malicious|benign). The metrics harness resolves every label to the matching reports in reports/, replays the CURRENT detection pipeline over each (scripts/replay_detection.py), and measures precision/recall/FPR against these labels. Seed it with the detection_tests scenarios (known ground truth); grow it by detonating real malware-by-family and a benign/goodware set, then labeling the resulting reports (see `detection_metrics.py --bootstrap` for a labeling worklist over existing reports). Filename matches every run of that sample -- fine for the detection_tests corpus, which is deliberately re-run many times.
